resources.string: Records the Spotify ads you want to keep
Shows when SpotAd is listening for ads and while it is recording
Confirms a new ad clip has been saved
SpotAd will save the next ad break automatically
Android requires the microphone permission for apps that capture playback audio. SpotAd never records from the microphone.
A notification is required by Android to keep the recorder running in the background.
Needed to read the Spotify media notification so SpotAd knows when an ad starts and ends. Only Spotify metadata is read.
Android only allows capturing app audio through a screen-capture consent dialog. Nothing is recorded until an ad is detected.
